sampack_emitweaks.configuration.clear_on: Clear the search bar when the creative inventory switches to another tab.
Clear the search bar when any inventory screen closes, creative or not. Going to EMI's recipe screens and back doesn't count, nor does switching between the survival and creative inventories.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.clear_bu: Show an x at the end of the search bar that clears it.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.history_: Show an arrow at the end of the search bar that opens a list of recent searches. Left-click one to search it again, right-click to forget it; the arrow keys and Enter work too, and Escape or a click elsewhere closes it. The clearing options can be switched at the foot of the list. While it's open, nothing under it reacts to the mouse.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.save_his: Keep the search history across restarts. Turning this off deletes the saved history.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.remi_scr: The same settings, in REMI's own config screen.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.icons_pe: How many icons are rendered each frame. Higher is faster, until the progress screen stutters.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.include_: Also write each stack's display name into meta.json.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.history_: Narrow the history list to the searches that contain what's typed in the search bar.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.rows.too: Item rows in the creative inventory, at most (vanilla: 5). Takes effect when it next opens.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.fit_to_s: Shrink the rows (never below vanilla's 5) to what the window has room for.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.groups.t: Fold items into REMI's stack groups, which open and close on click.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.creative: What a collapsed group shows in the creative inventory when its definition names no icon.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.follow_s: Filter the creative tabs, and the search tab's EMI index, by EMI's search bar.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.focus_se: Opening the search tab puts the keyboard focus in EMI's search bar.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.skip_bui: Leave out the stack groups REMI ships in its own jar (minecraft:planks, c:dyes, ...). The pack's groups and other mods' still load. Takes effect when EMI next reloads.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.remi_gro: What a collapsed stack group shows in EMI's panels when its json names no icon.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.title: SamPack EMI Tweaks
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.history_: Searches the history list shows at once (scroll it for the rest), and how many are kept. Keeping 0 turns the history off.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.export_s: Icon size in pixels when /emitweaks export or update_icons is given none, and the largest width and height of one sheet (2048 at 32px holds 4096 icons; also capped at what the GPU supports).
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.vertical: Width and height of REMI's creative tabs in a side sidebar.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.horizont: Width and height of REMI's creative tabs in a top or bottom sidebar.
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.tab_icon: Size of the icons on REMI's creative tabs, and how many tabs a sidebar shows (0 for as many as fit).
sampack_emitweaks.configuration.search_b: How far REMI moves the search bar left and down from where EMI puts it.
Space REMI's search bar texture adds around the text, across and down.
Color of the text you type, and of the grey hint shown while the bar is empty. #RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB.
